description: This Java class 'LibraryThingBookDataImport' is part of a book tracking application. It encapsulates a collection of books imported from LibraryThing, stored as a map, and provides a method to retrieve the books as a list.

classes.name: LibraryThingBookDataImport
classes.description: A class representing imported book data from LibraryThing, holding a map of book entries and providing a method to convert them into a list.

methods.name: asList
methods.description: Converts the internal map of books into a list of book import objects.
